messages:
Rafael Torres: quick pulse check after release: customers reported 2 blocking regressions and several low-sev annoyances. we also have 4 asks from a pilot customer that could reduce churn. do we split work or run a focused stability sprint?
Anya Singh: my +1 for a very short stability sprint (5 working days). knock out p0/p1s, then a light feature sprint. reduces blast radius.
Becky Moore: can we scope the pilot asks into an "incremental" path? one of them (context length bump) is big; others (export CSV, UX label) look small.
Luis Gomez: ops note: streaming timeout looks like KV cache miss under certain seq lengths. i can patch a conservative timeout and add telemetry quickly. will need a canary.
Rafael Torres: ok timeline proposal: Mon-Fri = stability (hotfix lane + backlog clean); next Mon-Wed = quick features: CSV export behind flag + UX labels; next Thu-Fri = plan for larger context work.
Anya Singh: prioritization rubric: customer-impact x effort. i pushed a tiny spreadsheet (link) and marked the two customer churn signals as must-fix.
Becky Moore: risk threshold: no feature merges during stability sprint except behind-experiment flags. also require smoke tests and perf check: p99 <= baseline *1.08.
Luis Gomez: ops checklist snippet for hotfix rollout:
```
- create canary pool (5%)
- run smoke + perf suite
- monitor p50/p95/p99
- rollback if error-rate > baseline*2
```
Rafael Torres: decision: we'll run the 5-day stability sprint. features that are tiny and behind flags can be queued but no full rollouts. we will reserve a single owner for the hotfix lane.
Anya Singh: owners: Becky -> CSV export (feature flag + telemetry), Luis -> streaming timeout patch + canary, Rafael -> billing retry fix + customer communication.
Becky Moore: i'll draft PR template for behind-flag merges and include required telemetry events (export_started, export_completed, export_failed).
OpsBot: scheduled canary window: Wed 02:00 - 06:00 UTC. Runbooks linked in #oncall.
Rafael Torres: action items: Becky -> PR template + small RFC by EOD; Luis -> canary + patch ready for Wednesday; Anya -> prioritize backlog and update pilot customer. i'll send a short customer note after hotfix. sync in 20m if needed.
Becky Moore: noted. i'll also add a tiny e2e that covers signup -> billing -> streaming to catch regressions early.
Rafael Torres: thanks all — short updates here are perfect. we'll reopen thread if blockers pop up :thumbsup:
